title: NGO Oversight, Civic Audit, and Democratic Renewal

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: Civil society watchdogs (*civil szervezetek*) serve as the democratic immune system. Operating open-source databases on public procurement (*közbeszerzések*), asset declarations, and court rulings, they hold public officials accountable.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: The ideal of public service (*közszolgálat*) is fundamentally ethical: true servants of the state embody impartiality (*pártatlanság*), resisting political capture to serve the broad public interest (*közérdek*).
